title: Race of the Rope Bridge
story: Skirlwind the Canyon Gnawer chews rope bridges strand by strand, cackling as travelers scramble. Today twelve goat-herders are stranded on the far ledge, and the great rope is 96 feet long with the Gnawer nibbling steadily. Mr 6 unrolls his spare cord and starts timing.
question: Skirlwind gnaws through 8 feet of rope every minute, while Mr 6's helpers splice 3.5 feet back on every minute. Starting from 96 feet of rope, how many minutes until the rope is gone?
solution: Each minute the rope really shrinks by 8 − 3.5 = 4.5 feet.
Time to lose all 96 feet: 96 ÷ 4.5 = 21.33 minutes.
The rope lasts about 21.33 minutes — plenty of time for the crossing.
praise: Using the gnawing speed was smart thinking — the splicing crew's 3.5 feet had to be subtracted first.
hint: Two things happen every minute: rope is lost AND rope is added. What's the net change per minute?
victory: The last herder hopped off with time to spare, and Skirlwind was left gnawing a rope that stubbornly refused to end. Mr 6 offered him a nice chewy carrot instead.
imagePrompt: A long-toothed windy beast gnawing the anchor rope of a swaying canyon bridge while a numeral-six knight and helpers splice new cord in swirling dusty light.
